blockingFindings.title: Tests only assert exported symbol existence
blockingFindings.rationale: This is a static anti-pattern that would pass without exercising production behavior, and the acceptance requirements have no corresponding behavioral test coverage despite being marked covered.
blockingFindings.issue: All four tests use `typeof ... === "function"` checks against module exports and do not invoke scenario-validity behavior, construct baseline authority cases, inspect diffs, verify artifacts, or assert transitions. These tests would pass if the implementation merely exported stub functions while none of R1-R4 behavior worked.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Replace the export-existence checks with executable spec-local tests that exercise production behavior for authority validation failures, immutable-baseline diff computation, current-flow change detection, and artifact/transition outcomes.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a static anti-pattern that would pass without exercising production behavior, and the acceptance requirements have no corresponding behavioral test coverage despite being marked covered.

blockingFindings.title: R1 authority validation coverage is incomplete
blockingFindings.rationale: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage for several required failure modes.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests only cover missing repairBaseline and mismatched refs. They do not cover commit identity agreement with persisted authority, ambiguous authority, or unresolvable authority, all of which R1 explicitly requires to fail closed with typed errors before diffing.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local unit tests that exercise persisted-authority commit mismatch plus ambiguous and unresolvable baseline authority cases, asserting the typed fail-closed errors.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage for several required failure modes.

blockingFindings.title: R2 production-target change detection is not covered
blockingFindings.rationale: R2 and R4 require these behaviors, but the current tests would pass without exercising the production behavior that detects those change categories.
blockingFindings.issue: The R2 test only checks that diff args start with the baseline ref. It does not cover committed diff computation from the immutable baseline, advanced-base exclusion, or retained staged, unstaged, and untracked production-target detection using the existing allowlist.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add tests that exercise committed current-flow changes from the validated immutable baseline, advanced-base exclusion, and staged/unstaged/untracked production-target changes through the allowlist behavior.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R2 and R4 require these behaviors, but the current tests would pass without exercising the production behavior that detects those change categories.

blockingFindings.title: R3 public contract behavior is not tested
blockingFindings.rationale: The coverage artifact marks R3 as covered, but the actual test contradicts that claim and does not cover the required public contract.
blockingFindings.issue: The R3-labeled test asserts an invalid authority helper error, not the scenario-validity public contract. It does not verify version-1 result artifact writing, raw log writing, pass/block semantics, or advancement of pass results to test review.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Replace or supplement the R3 test with executable coverage of valid scenario-validity runs writing the v1 result artifact and raw log, preserving pass/block outcomes, and transitioning pass results to test review.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The coverage artifact marks R3 as covered, but the actual test contradicts that claim and does not cover the required public contract.

blockingFindings.title: R4 coverage claim is contradicted by the test body
blockingFindings.rationale: The requirement-to-test coverage artifact says R4 is covered, but the actual tests do not cover most of R4.
blockingFindings.issue: The R4-labeled test only duplicates a baseline authority mismatch assertion. It does not cover the R4-required advanced-base exclusion, committed/staged/unstaged/untracked current-flow changes, invalid baseline authority breadth, or retained artifact/transition behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add the missing R4 unit cases or narrow the coverage artifact so it does not claim R4 is covered until those cases exist.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement-to-test coverage artifact says R4 is covered, but the actual tests do not cover most of R4.

blockingFindings.title: R3 pass artifact test cannot exercise pass contract
blockingFindings.rationale: R3 requires preserved valid-run artifact and transition behavior, but the current spec-local test cannot validly reach a passing scenario-validity run.
blockingFindings.issue: `writeScenarioFixture()` creates `expected-failure.test.js` with tests that always call `assert.fail("implementation is pending")`, yet the R3 test immediately expects `command.execute()` to return `result: "pass"`, `next: "test-review"`, and a pass artifact. This test contradicts its own fixture and the target scenario-validity API behavior, so it cannot provide executable coverage for retained pass artifact/transition behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Use a passing scenario fixture for the pass portion of R3, then introduce the production-target change only for the block portion.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3 requires preserved valid-run artifact and transition behavior, but the current spec-local test cannot validly reach a passing scenario-validity run.
blockingFindings.failureKind: test is not executable or clearly contradicts the target API

blockingFindings.title: R4 omits required untracked production change coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: The requirement-to-test artifact marks R4 covered, but the actual test omits one of R4's named mandatory coverage classes.
blockingFindings.issue: R4 explicitly requires unit coverage for committed, staged, unstaged, and untracked current-flow changes, but the R4 test only creates committed `src/committed.js`, staged `src/staged.js`, and unstaged tracked files (`tests/retained.test.js`, `package.json`). It does not create or assert any untracked production-target file.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an untracked production-target file to the R4 fixture and assert it appears in `listScenarioValidityPreflightFiles()` output.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement-to-test artifact marks R4 covered, but the actual test omits one of R4's named mandatory coverage classes.
blockingFindings.failureKind: acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage

blockingFindings.title: R4 retained transition assertion encodes block behavior, not pass transition
blockingFindings.rationale: The requirement-to-test coverage artifact says R4 covers retained artifact/transition behavior, but the actual test contradicts that coverage by asserting only the block path.
blockingFindings.issue: The R4 test name and requirement claim coverage for retained pass transition behavior, but the executable assertion expects `outcome.ok === false` and `SCENARIO_VALIDITY_BLOCKED` after creating production-target changes. It never asserts advancement of a pass result to test review.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a pass-path assertion in R4, or remove pass-transition coverage from R4 and rely on a corrected R3 pass-path test.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement-to-test coverage artifact says R4 covers retained artifact/transition behavior, but the actual test contradicts that coverage by asserting only the block path.
blockingFindings.failureKind: requirement coverage artifact contradicts the actual test files

requirements.desc: Validate repairBaseline authority before scenario-validity computes its preflight diff: its flow identity, ref, and commit identity must agree with persisted authority; missing, mismatched, ambiguous, or unresolvable authority returns a typed fail-closed error.
Compute scenario-validity's committed diff from the validated immutable baseline while retaining detection of staged, unstaged, and untracked production-target changes from the existing allowlist.
Preserve the scenario-validity public contract: valid runs write the version-1 result artifact and raw log, retain pass/block semantics, and advance pass results to test review.
Add unit coverage for advanced-base exclusion, committed/staged/unstaged/untracked current-flow changes, invalid baseline authority, and retained artifact/transition behavior.
